definitions.explanation: A body of water partially enclosed by land, forming an indentation in the coastline. Used in geographical and maritime contexts.

examples.japanese: {海湾|かいわん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ships are anchored in the bay.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{海湾|かいわん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良港|りょうこう}→良港：28679_ryoukou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This bay is known as a natural good harbor.

examples.japanese: {海湾|かいわん}{沿|ぞ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧になっている。
examples.english: In the areas along the bay, fishing and tourism are the main industries.

notes:
A compound of {海|かい} (sea) and ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧ (bay), used as a slightly more formal or literary term for a bay or gulf. In everyday speech, ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧ alone is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海湾|かいわん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: bay area; gulf region
- {海湾|かいわん}{沿|ぞ}い: along the bay
- {海湾|かいわん}⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: gulf states (as in the Persian Gulf countries)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湾|わん}→湾：03796_wan⟧: bay; gulf (the standard, more common term)
- ⟦{入|い}り{江|え}→入り江：05040_irie⟧: inlet; cove (smaller than a bay)
- {内海|ないかい}: inland sea (a sea largely enclosed by land)

USAGE:
The term {海湾|かいわん} appears in formal or geographical contexts. In news coverage of the Middle East, {海湾|かいわん}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧ (Gulf War) and {海湾|かいわん}⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧ (Gulf states) are commonly encountered usages.
